scripts.version: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=require('./package.json'); const m=require('./src/manifest.json'); m.version=p.version; fs.writeFileSync('./src/manifest.json', JSON.stringify(m, null, '\t') + '\n');" && prettier --write src/manifest.json
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run lint && web-ext build --source-dir src --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.build:source: npm run prebuild && npm run lint && node scripts/build-source.mjs
scripts.update: npm update && npm ci && npm i
